items.name: Leonel F.
items.quote: I drove all the way from Encino to Orange County just to get a special service for my vehicle at Oasis Detailing Supplies and I can honestly say it was worth every mile and penny.

items.name: Walter V.
items.quote: Didn't try to sell me stuff I didn't need, but gave me exactly what I needed. Very friendly service. Customer for life.

items.name: Kenny G.
items.quote: Hardest working guy in the business. Beautiful results. Worth it every time!

items.name: Jaime V.
items.quote: Second time coming to this store for supplies to clean my car at home — so friendly, helpful, and knowledgeable about their products! Will be coming back when I need a refill!

items.name: Brian G.
items.quote: The lady who runs this place showed me how to use the water machine — I get all my car wash water here now. Never leaves water stains or mineral spots like the tap water at my house.
